tasks.title: Brain search + category tagging shipped
tasks.note:
✅ What was built:

1. Search tab (press 7 or click Search) — unified search across:
   - All project log tasks (title + notes, instant in-memory)
   - Brain wiki files (GitHub Code Search, searches file contents)
   Clicking a task navigates to Tasks/Output tab. Clicking a wiki result opens it in Brain.

2. Brain tab — Category field above the raw note textarea.
   Type e.g. 'suppliers' or 'building standards' → saves as #suppliers tag at the top of the raw note so Claude can route it to the right wiki folder.

🔍 What to check in the UI:
- Tab 'Search' appears in the tabs strip (keyboard: 7)
- Type a keyword from a task title → see matching task cards appear instantly
- With brain repo set: type a keyword, click 'Search brain →' → wiki results appear
- Brain tab → Category field visible above the note textarea
- Push a note with category 'suppliers' → the raw file in GitHub starts with #suppliers

⚠️ Notes:
- Brain wiki search requires GitHub token with repo read access (same token already used)
- GitHub Code Search may return 0 results on private repos without the right scope — ensure token has 'repo' scope
- Web/online search not included; that would require an external search API key

Files changed: app/src/components/SearchTab.jsx (new), app/src/components/BrainTab.jsx, app/src/api/github.js, app/src/App.jsx, app/src/App.css
